content:
The art director responsible for the visual design and concept of the mascot for the MacBook Neo ad campaign, Sofia Coelho, has shared rare behind-the-scenes insights into the birth of "Little Finder Guy." Details below.

"The height is exactly one apple"

Apple art director Sofia Coelho posted on LinkedIn today, sharing a series of interesting behind-the-scenes photos that showcase the process of creating the character "Little Finder Guy" for the MacBook Neo ad campaign.

In her post, written in a lighthearted and humorous birthday announcement style, Coelho thanked the colleagues involved in this Cannes Lions award-nominated campaign, describing the opportunity to lead the visual design and concept of this character as a "dream design project."

She also shared a photo containing hand-drawn sketches and research on "Little Finder Guy" featuring various expressions, proportions, and overall styling, and there appears to be a physical prototype painted with a spray gun.

"Little Finder Guy" has made frequent appearances throughout the entire MacBook Neo ad campaign. Apple not only had this character star in a livestream event but also launched a series of TikTok short videos. The character quickly became a meme online, inspiring fans to create fan art, wallpapers, 3D printed models, and other various works.

This character also appeared as an Easter egg in at least one WWDC 2026 session, and was featured on a badge included in the attendee souvenir goodie bag.
